name: mobile-visual-validation
description: Validate mobile visuals and build reproducible localized Store screenshots or vertical app showcase videos from real captures.

provenance.reason: Owner asked (10 Oct 2026) to make the store screenshot method reusable beyond Presi: restore the skill overwritten by test previews, add a generic store-frame renderer (reproduces Presi's accepted v2 pack to under 1/255 mean pixel difference), its pack schema, store sizes and capture traps, and record the Google Play framing rule lifted by the owner on 6 Sept 2026.
